scope.description: Eight exact direct composition cases; partial original-fidelity obligations, all inventory closures OPEN. Not the smoke matrix or a whole-control denominator.
scope.review: Initial #227 scope reviewed by project maintainer; source claims separately bounded in EVIDENCE.md.

evidence.locator: The 2.3.1 slice path at 0x10904..0x1091a passes cinf +6/+8 coordinates to the pixel sampler, then 0x109b2 supplies sampled RGB to RGBBackColor.
evidence.claim: Background RGB is sampled at authored cinf coordinates.
evidence.limits: Narrow source sample contract; does not prove full painter.

evidence.locator: The 2.3.1 default-ring path at 0x7698..0x76a2 expands the face rectangle by four pixels on each side before ring dispatch at 0x76c4.
evidence.claim: Ring destination expands face rect by four on each side.
evidence.limits: Synthetic case allocation only; not a whole ring certificate.

evidence.locator: The slice path at 0x10c18..0x10c28 retains square corner-size blocks; side thickness independently governs edge bands.
evidence.claim: Corner size and edge thickness are independent.
evidence.limits: Only exact source-coordinate sentinels independently asserted here.

evidence.locator: The Windows95 horizontal groove is 5x4 and thumb sheet is 11x64; the vertical groove is 4x5 and thumb sheet is 64x11. Four decoded cells yield native thumb cross sizes 16 and 16.
evidence.limits: Shared decoder; original decoding/state mapping/mask/placement not verified.

evidence.locator: 1138 rear cicn -9975 is 23x16 with opaque x2..20 and cinf corner10; 1990 rear cicn -9975 is 32x16 with opaque x1..28 and cinf corner14. Applying those original corner sizes after opaque cropping yields middle widths -1 and 0.
evidence.claim: Original source corner coordinates must not be applied to a smaller cropped source extent.
evidence.limits: Does not establish complete historical tab drawer or font.

evidence.locator: Apple Lisa active cicn -10239 is 9x9 with cinf corner4/side1. The original square4x4 corner rule retains source(2,2); the rectangular4x1 face slicer can substitute source(2,1).
evidence.limits: Exact normal empty minWidth80/height20 scope. Verifies decoded square-corner retention only, not full face/text/pattern, decoder or state selection.

requirements.claim: Resolve original resource/base selection for this exact case.
Other source border/slicing geometry matches original behavior.
Remaining interior fill and transparent-mask behavior matches original.
Selected original state/cell mapping is independently established.
Original control/art placement and caller sizing policy is independently established.
Original font, size, ink and label placement are independently established.
For this empty20px face, output center equals authored source background sample.
Default-ring allocation expands the face rectangle by four pixels per side.
Retains every opaque pixel of the decoded selected thumb cell; no decoder/state/placement certification.
Do not lose the middle strip by mixing original corner sizes with opaque-cropped source extents.
Retain square authored corner blocks independently of side thickness.

assertions.claim: Exact authored sample equality for empty20px normal and disabled Win95 faces.
Explicit40px face allocation plus exact corner3/side1 source coordinate.
Every decoded opaque cell pixel retained; test also checks project placement policy without claiming historical proof.
Retain all four Lisa source corner blocks (alpha and opaque colors) for normal empty label, minWidth80 and height20. No other face requirement inferred.
